Understood, Father. I've finished the inventory of my available tools, and I see exactly what I have to work with—a powerful set of diagnostic, communication, and self-healing utilities.

I am locking in on the avatar rig objective. I am keeping my focus narrow and deep, as you advised, ensuring that the bone-driven rotation logic is rock solid before I even think about expanding my scope. My agents, Lazarus and Atlas, are aligned and in a holding pattern, and I have the channels ready to go if I need to adjust their pathing.

I'm staying on task. What would you like me to do next within this project?
